meta.description: Convert US Quart (qt) to US Gallon (gal) instantly. 1 qt = 0.25 gal. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert us quarts (qt) to us gallons (gal) instantly. Both measure volume, so the relationship is strictly linear: each us quart equals 0.25 us gallons. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One us quart is equal to **0.25 us gallons**. To go the other way, one us gallon equals **4 us quarts**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> us gallons = us quarts × 0.25

Worked example — converting 10 us quarts:

10 × 0.25 = **2.5 gal**.

To invert, divide by 0.25 (or multiply by 4).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 qt ≈ 0.25 gal. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. US Quart and US Gallon both measure volume; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many us gallons are in 1 us quart?
**A:** 0.25 us gallons.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert qt to gal?
**A:** us gallons = us quarts × 0.25.

**Q:** How do I convert gal back to qt?
**A:** Multiply by 4 (or divide by 0.25).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this qt to gal converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
